hooks.text: 每次点击都会推动游戏继续进化，并逐步解锁等级、能力与按钮构筑
hooks.excerpt: The more you click the button, the more the game evolves. Level up, acquire new abilities, choose your playstyle, and build a powerful button!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可无限游玩并几乎收齐全部能力，最终让屏幕进入能力全面叠加的失控状态
hooks.excerpt: The game can be played indefinitely, allowing you to acquire (almost) every single ability, which will then cause there to be way too much stuff going at once.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四种结局对构筑偏好不同，需要围绕目标结局反向选择能力
hooks.excerpt: The game can be beaten via 1 of 4 endings. Some builds will make certain endings easier than others, which encourages you to choose specific abilities for whatever ending you will attempt.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
